senses.en: a vessel for travelling on water, usually smaller than a ship

ex.en: We hired a small boat and explored the lake.
ex.zh: 我们租了一条小船，游览了湖面。

ex.en: In remote coastal communities, travelling by boat remains essential for accessing schools and medical services.
ex.zh: 在偏远的沿海社区，乘船出行仍是获得教育和医疗服务的重要方式。

tip: by boat不加冠词；on a boat表示在船上。

senses.en: People or things together or connected by a shared feature.
Arrange people or things together, often according to shared features.

ex.en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
ex.zh: 一群骑行者在村里的面包店外停了下来。

ex.en: Teachers can group students by their learning needs to provide more effective support during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 教师可以根据学生的学习需求分组，以便在课堂活动中提供更有效的支持。

tip: a group of后常接复数名词；动词常用group A by B。

senses.en: the number 19

ex.en: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
ex.zh: 当时是7点19分。

ex.en: I was only nineteen (19 years old ).
ex.zh: 我当时只有19岁。

senses.en: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves.
An organised group seeking political power through shared policies.
A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.

ex.en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在花园里办了一场小聚会。

ex.en: Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 每个政党都应说明其教育政策将如何惠及弱势背景的学生。

tip: 合同中的party指当事方，不是聚会或政党。

senses.en: the legally or socially recognised relationship between two spouses
a successful combination of different things

ex.en: Their marriage grew stronger as they learned to listen.
ex.zh: 随着他们学会倾听，婚姻关系变得更加稳固。

ex.en: Changing attitudes towards marriage have influenced household structures and housing demand in many societies.
ex.zh: 在许多社会中，人们对婚姻态度的变化影响了家庭结构和住房需求。

col: marriage to someone｜与某人的婚姻
tip: marriage指婚姻关系；wedding主要指婚礼。

senses.en: Free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.
To remove dirt or unwanted substances from something.
Producing little or no pollution.

ex.en: There are clean towels on the shelf beside you.
ex.zh: 你旁边的架子上有干净的毛巾。

ex.en: Investing in clean energy can reduce air pollution while creating new employment opportunities in developing industries.
ex.zh: 投资清洁能源可以减少空气污染，同时在新兴产业中创造就业机会。

tip: clean是干净；clear是清澈或清楚，不能随意互换。

senses.en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。

ex.en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
ex.zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。

col: reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子
tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

senses.en: the rear part of an animal or an aircraft
to follow someone closely and watch where they go

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
ex.zh: 我回家时，那只狗摇起了尾巴。

ex.en: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
ex.zh: 一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。

tip: tail指尾巴；tale指故事，两词同音。

senses.en: Used to make an adjective or adverb stronger.
Used to emphasize an exact person, thing, place, or time.

ex.en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 汤很烫，先让它凉一凉。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
ex.zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通非常重要。

tip: very通常修饰形容词或副词；修饰动词常用very much。

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

ex.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
ex.zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。

ex.en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
ex.zh: 向顾客收取塑料袋费用，可以鼓励购物者养成更环保的习惯。

col: a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子
tip: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

senses.en: the day after Monday and before Wednesday

ex.en: We usually have dinner together on Tuesday evenings.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期二晚上一起吃饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Tuesday to help newcomers settle into the area.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周二提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者适应当地生活。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；every Tuesday前不用on。

senses.en: To decide that something planned will not happen.
To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.

ex.en: We had to cancel our picnic because of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 由于下大雨，我们不得不取消野餐。

ex.en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
ex.zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。

tip: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

senses.en: A drawing showing where places or features are located
To draw or record the position of places or features

ex.en: We spread the map across the table before leaving.
ex.zh: 出发前，我们把地图铺在桌上。

ex.en: Researchers use satellite images to map changes in forest cover and identify areas needing urgent protection.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用卫星图像绘制森林覆盖变化图，并确定急需保护的区域。

col: map out a route｜规划路线
tip: map作动词时，过去式mapped，分词mapping。

senses.zh: 祖父母或外祖父母之一
senses.en: The father or mother of one of your parents.

ex.en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
ex.zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
ex.zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母
tip: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

senses.en: the natural object that moves around Earth
a natural object that moves around a planet

ex.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
ex.zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
ex.zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。

col: the surface of the moon｜月球表面
tip: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。

senses.zh: 是； 有，存在； 做，成为； 发生
senses.en: used with a present participle to form the  continuous 4  tenses of verbs

senses.zh: (Be)人名；(缅)拜；(日)部(姓)；(朝)培；(中非)贝

ex.en: They’ve been asking a lot of questions.
ex.zh: 他们已经问了许多问题。

ex.en: We’ll be starting in about an hour.
ex.zh: 我们过一小时左右开始。

senses.en: the United States of America
North and South America considered together

ex.en: My cousin moved to America to study engineering.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到美国去学工程。

ex.en: Many universities in America attract international students through their research facilities and diverse academic programmes.
ex.zh: 美国的许多大学凭借研究设施和多样化的学术课程吸引国际学生。

tip: 日常多指美国；南北美洲合称常用the Americas。

senses.en: To require something because it is necessary or important
Something necessary or the condition of requiring it
A situation in which essential things are lacking

ex.en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，这些植物需要更多的水。

ex.en: Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市若想减少人们对私家车的依赖，就需要改善公共交通。

col: need to do something｜需要做某事
meet basic needs｜满足基本需求
tip: need to do表需要做；need doing表需要被做。

senses.en: Recently made, discovered, introduced, or begun.
Recently obtained or experienced by someone, though possibly already existing.
Not yet familiar with a place, activity, or situation.

ex.en: Our new neighbours brought us a basket of apples.
ex.zh: 我们的新邻居送来了一篮苹果。

ex.en: New technologies can make healthcare more accessible, but their benefits must be shared across different income groups.
ex.zh: 新技术能让医疗服务更易获得，但不同收入群体都应能享受到这些益处。

col: new to the job｜刚接触这份工作
tip: be new to表示初次接触、不熟悉，to是介词。

senses.en: A small official sticker showing that postage has been paid.
A tool that presses a mark, or the mark it leaves.
Press a mark onto something, or bring a foot down hard.

ex.en: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
ex.zh: 她出门前在信封上贴了一张邮票。

ex.en: Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信减少了书信往来，集邮仍是一种探索历史与文化的方式。

col: stamp a passport｜在护照上盖章
tip: 邮票用a stamp；“在信封上贴邮票”用put a stamp on。

senses.en: not having, using, or being accompanied by someone or something
not doing the action mentioned

ex.en: I left the house without my keys this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我出门时没带钥匙。

ex.en: Cities cannot achieve lasting reductions in air pollution without investing in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不投资可靠的公共交通，城市就无法持久地减少空气污染。

col: without saying a word｜一言不发地
tip: without 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词-ing。

senses.en: moving or acting fast, without much delay
taking only a short time

ex.en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
ex.zh: 她反应敏捷，及时接住了差点掉落的玻璃杯。

ex.en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
ex.zh: 对水污染报告作出迅速回应，可以防止附近生态系统遭受严重破坏。

tip: 正式表达中用副词quickly修饰动作。

senses.en: Something said or done to make people laugh.
To say something funny or not seriously meant.

ex.en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。

col: play a joke on someone｜捉弄某人
joke about something｜拿某事开玩笑
tip: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。

senses.en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
information arranged in rows and columns

ex.en: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们围坐在桌边，一起吃新鲜面包。

ex.en: The table compares average household spending on transport in three cities over a ten-year period.
ex.zh: 该表比较了三个城市十年间的家庭平均交通支出。

tip: set the table指摆餐具，不是摆放桌子。

ex.en: He emphasized its importance to me.
ex.zh: 他向我强调它的重要性。

ex.en: The child read the story but did not comprehend its meaning.
ex.zh: 这个孩子读了这篇故事，但不能理解它的意思。

senses.zh: 检查，核对；制止，抑制；在…上打勾
senses.en: to do something in order to find out whether something really is correct, true, or in good condition
something that controls something else and stops it from getting worse, continuing to happen etc

ex.en: Check the tiles carefully before you buy them.
ex.zh: 购买之前要把瓷砖仔细检查一下。

ex.en: A first rule in solving any mystery is to check the facts.
ex.zh: 揭开谜团的第一条规则是核查事实。

senses.en: A tall African animal with a long neck and spotted coat

ex.en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
ex.zh: 那只长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining healthy giraffe populations and preserving biodiversity in African grasslands.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持健康的长颈鹿种群和保护非洲草原的生物多样性至关重要。

col: a herd of giraffes｜一群长颈鹿
tip: 重音在第二音节，复数通常加-s。

senses.en: an image made by drawing, painting, or taking a photograph
an idea or description of what a situation is like
to form an image of someone or something in your mind

ex.en: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床头上方挂了一幅海景画。

ex.en: Survey results provide a clearer picture of how housing costs affect the wellbeing of young adults.
ex.zh: 调查结果更清楚地呈现了住房成本如何影响年轻成年人的幸福感。

col: picture yourself doing something｜想象自己做某事
tip: take a picture是拍照；draw a picture是画画。

senses.en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately
an affectionate touch made with the lips

ex.en: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 她上班前轻轻亲了亲女儿。

ex.en: In some cultures, a kiss on the cheek is a common greeting between close friends.
ex.zh: 在一些文化中，亲吻脸颊是亲密朋友之间常见的问候方式。

col: kiss someone goodbye｜亲吻某人道别
give someone a kiss｜亲某人一下
a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻
tip: 吻某人的脸颊用 kiss someone on the cheek。

senses.en: More than two but not many
A few people or things already mentioned or understood

ex.en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
ex.zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。

ex.en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
ex.zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: several of them｜他们中的几个
for several reasons｜出于几个原因
tip: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

senses.en: To regularly check something for changes, progress, or problems.
A screen displaying information, or a device checking conditions.

ex.en: The nurse monitored my temperature throughout the night.
ex.zh: 护士整晚都在监测我的体温。

ex.en: Governments should monitor air quality regularly to assess whether environmental policies are effectively reducing pollution.
ex.zh: 政府应定期监测空气质量，以评估环境政策是否有效减少了污染。

col: monitor air quality｜监测空气质量
tip: 作动词可直接接宾语：monitor changes监测变化。

senses.en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their culture.
ex.zh: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: A car with a driver whom you pay for a journey.
To move slowly on the ground before takeoff or after landing.

ex.en: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
ex.zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。

ex.en: Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车
tip: 乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

senses.en: The condition of someone's body and mind.
How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.

ex.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
ex.zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。

ex.en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。

tip: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

senses.en: A conversation or discussion, especially to exchange views
The words spoken by characters in a story or performance

ex.en: The neighbours began a friendly dialogue about their shared garden.
ex.zh: 邻居们就共用花园展开了友好的交流。

ex.en: Open dialogue between teachers and parents can help schools respond more effectively to children's needs.
ex.zh: 教师与家长之间的坦诚对话有助于学校更有效地回应儿童的需求。

col: dialogue between communities｜社区间的对话
tip: 既指现实中的交流，也指小说、电影等作品中的对白。

senses.en: having happened or started a short time ago

ex.en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
ex.zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？

ex.en: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。

tip: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。

senses.en: the number 10

ex.en: Snow had been falling steadily for ten days.
ex.zh: 雪已经连续下了10天了。

ex.en: I need to be home by ten (ten o’clock ).
ex.zh: 我得在10点之前回家。

senses.en: having the colour of a clear daytime sky
the colour of a clear daytime sky
feeling sad or unhappy

ex.en: He wore a blue jacket to the picnic.
ex.zh: 他穿了一件蓝色夹克去野餐。

ex.en: Urban designers often use blue surfaces to create a sense of calm in busy public spaces.
ex.zh: 城市设计师常使用蓝色的表面，在繁忙的公共空间营造宁静感。

tip: feel blue表示心情低落；颜色较浅用light blue。

senses.en: having little or no light
having a colour closer to black than white
the absence of light, especially at night

ex.en: The hallway was too dark to find my shoes.
ex.zh: 走廊太暗了，我找不到自己的鞋。

ex.en: Poorly lit streets can feel dark and unsafe, discouraging residents from walking after sunset.
ex.zh: 照明不足的街道会显得昏暗、不安全，使居民不愿在日落后步行。

col: in the dark｜在黑暗中；不知情
tip: dark既指光线暗，也指颜色深；黑暗常用the dark。

senses.en: the arrangement of things or a controlled, peaceful situation
to request goods or food, or tell someone what to do
a request for goods or an instruction that must be obeyed

ex.en: Please put these photos in the correct order.
ex.zh: 请把这些照片按正确顺序排列。

ex.en: Online shoppers can now order fresh produce directly from local farms, supporting regional economies.
ex.zh: 网购者如今可以直接向当地农场订购新鲜农产品，从而支持地区经济。

col: order someone to do something｜命令某人做某事
tip: in order指按顺序；in order to后接动词，表示为了。

senses.en: a rounded object laid by female birds and some other animals
a female reproductive cell that can develop after fertilisation

ex.en: She cracked an egg into the hot frying pan.
ex.zh: 她把一个鸡蛋打进了热煎锅。

ex.en: Eggs provide an affordable source of protein and can form part of a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 鸡蛋是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，可以成为均衡饮食的一部分。

tip: scrambled eggs指炒蛋；egg white指蛋清。

senses.en: An emotional state or response to something
A physical sensation or the ability to sense touch
An impression or belief not necessarily supported by evidence

ex.en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
ex.zh: 考试结束后，我顿时感到如释重负。

ex.en: A strong feeling of belonging can improve students' confidence and encourage participation in school activities.
ex.zh: 强烈的归属感可以增强学生的自信，并鼓励他们参与学校活动。

col: a feeling of relief｜如释重负的感觉
hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情
tip: feelings常指感情；have a feeling that表示直觉。

senses.zh: 在（表示存在或出现的地点、场所、位置、空间）；以（某种价格、速度等）；向；达；因为；朝；忙于
senses.en: used to say what event or activity someone is taking part in

senses.zh: 阿特（老挝货币基本单位att）；砹（极不稳定放射性元素）

ex.en: I met my wife at a disco.
ex.zh: 我在迪斯科舞会上认识了我的妻子。

ex.en: The matter was discussed at a meeting of the finance committee.
ex.zh: 这件事在财务委员会的会议上讨论过了。

senses.en: introduces a condition for something to happen
introduces an indirect question about whether something is true

ex.en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
ex.zh: 如果下雨，我们可以改在室内玩。

ex.en: If cities invest in safe cycling routes, more residents may choose bicycles for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 如果城市投资建设安全的自行车道，更多居民可能会选择骑车进行日常出行。

tip: 谈未来条件时，if从句通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: a part of something or a single item
a work of writing, music, or art
to join separate parts to make something complete

ex.en: She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
ex.zh: 她把最后一块蛋糕留给了弟弟。

ex.en: Each piece of evidence should be carefully assessed before researchers draw conclusions about environmental change.
ex.zh: 研究人员在对环境变化作出结论前，应仔细评估每一项证据。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
a piece of equipment｜一件设备
a piece of music｜一首乐曲
tip: a piece of可量化advice等不可数名词。

senses.en: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about
used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about

ex.en: It was he who first suggested the idea.
ex.zh: 是他先提出这个想法的。

senses.en: Without anything or anyone coming between.
To guide or control an activity, performance, or group.
To show the way or aim something towards a place.

ex.en: There is a direct train from here to the airport.
ex.zh: 这里有直达机场的火车。

ex.en: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。

col: direct attention to｜将注意力转向
tip: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。

senses.en: a rodent with a long tail, larger than a mouse

ex.en: A rat disappeared behind the bins near the gate.
ex.zh: 一只大鼠钻到大门附近的垃圾桶后面，不见了。

ex.en: Proper waste management helps control rat populations and reduces health risks in densely populated neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 妥善管理垃圾有助于控制鼠群数量，并降低人口密集社区的健康风险。

tip: rat通常指大鼠，mouse通常指体型较小的小鼠。

senses.en: A male who has one or both parents in common with you.

ex.en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
ex.zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的自行车。

ex.en: Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.
ex.zh: 哥哥姐姐可以通过经常在家陪弟弟妹妹阅读来帮助他们学习。

tip: brother不区分兄弟；用older或younger说明长幼。

senses.en: the study of Earth's places, environments, and human activity
the physical features and arrangement of a particular area

ex.en: In geography today, we learned how rivers shape valleys.
ex.zh: 今天的地理课上，我们学习了河流如何塑造河谷。

ex.en: The geography of coastal regions influences settlement patterns and determines how communities respond to rising sea levels.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的地理特征影响聚居格局，并决定当地社区如何应对海平面上升。

tip: geography是地理学；geology是地质学。

senses.en: Tell someone what you think they should do
Officially give someone information about something

ex.en: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
ex.zh: 医生建议我休息几天。

ex.en: Schools should advise students on career options before they choose subjects for further study.
ex.zh: 学校应在学生选择进修科目之前，就职业选择向他们提供建议。

col: advise someone to do something｜建议某人做某事
tip: advise是动词；advice是不可数名词，词尾发/s/。

senses.en: To produce words or images on paper using a machine
Letters and words produced on paper by printing
A mark left by something pressed against a surface

ex.en: Could you print two copies of this recipe?
ex.zh: 你能把这份食谱打印两份吗？

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to print assignments only when physical copies are necessary.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生仅在需要纸质版时打印作业，以减少纸张浪费。

col: in print｜已出版且仍可购得
tip: print out指打印出来；out of print则指书已绝版。

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。

ex.en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
ex.zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

col: hold a festival｜举办节庆活动
tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

senses.en: following the length or direction of something
forward from one place towards another
with someone when they go somewhere

ex.en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路沿线植树可以为行人遮阴，并改善城市面貌。

col: bring someone along｜带某人一起来
tip: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。

senses.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

ex.en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。

ex.en: Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 保护天然森林有助于维护生物多样性，并减少大气中的二氧化碳含量。

tip: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。

senses.en: a round fruit with firm flesh and red or green skin

ex.en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
ex.zh: 我装了一个苹果和一个三明治当午餐。

ex.en: Providing fresh fruit, such as apples, in schools may encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 在学校提供苹果等新鲜水果，可能有助于鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 可数名词；“一个苹果”用an apple。

senses.en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients

ex.en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
ex.zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。

ex.en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。

tip: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

senses.en: a small animal with long ears, soft fur, and strong back legs

ex.en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
ex.zh: 一只白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地，朝我们跑来。

ex.en: Introducing rabbits into new environments can damage native vegetation and disrupt the balance of local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 将兔子引入新环境可能破坏原生植被，扰乱当地生态系统的平衡。

tip: rabbit泛指兔；hare通常指腿耳更长的野兔。

senses.zh: 我们（主格）；笔者，本人（作者或演讲人使用）；朕，寡人
senses.en: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people

ex.en: Shall we stop for a coffee?
ex.zh: 我们停下来喝杯咖啡好吗？

ex.en: So we all travelled down to Brighton together.
ex.zh: 所以我们一起都去了布赖顿。

senses.zh: 你（们）的东西；你的责任；你的家属；来信，尊函
senses.en: used when speaking or writing to one or more people to refer to something that belongs to them or is connected with them

senses.zh: 你（们）的（东西）；信末署名前用语

ex.en: This is our room, and yours is just across the hall.
ex.zh: 这是我们的房间，你们的在走廊那边。

ex.en: A lot of people have money problems, but yours are more serious than most people’s.
ex.zh: 许多人有财务问题，不过你的问题比大多数人的要严重。

senses.en: A place where people buy goods or services.
To visit stores or websites to look for and buy things.

ex.en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Independent shops can strengthen local economies by creating jobs and keeping spending within the community.
ex.zh: 独立商店可以通过创造就业并让消费留在社区内，促进地方经济。

tip: 买某类商品用shop for；泛指去购物用go shopping。

senses.en: The one or ones belonging to them

ex.en: Our garden is small, but theirs has several trees.
ex.zh: 我们的花园很小，但他们的花园里有好几棵树。

ex.en: Some families own their homes, while others rent theirs because property prices remain beyond their reach.
ex.zh: 有些家庭拥有自己的住房，另一些则因房价仍超出承受能力而租房居住。

col: a friend of theirs｜他们的一位朋友
ours and theirs｜我们的和他们的
tip: theirs独立使用，后不接名词，也不加撇号。

senses.en: Covered with or containing water or another liquid
Having rain or frequent rainfall
To put water or another liquid onto something

ex.en: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
ex.zh: 我踩进水坑，把袜子弄湿了。

ex.en: Prolonged wet weather can damage crops and make it harder for farmers to harvest them efficiently.
ex.zh: 持续的阴雨天气会损害庄稼，使农民更难高效收获。

tip: damp指微湿；soaking wet表示湿透。

senses.en: To speak or call out in a very loud voice.
A loud call or cry made with the voice.

ex.en: We shouted across the river, but nobody heard us.
ex.zh: 我们朝河对岸大喊，却没有人听见。

ex.en: In noisy classrooms, teachers may need to shout, which can strain their voices over time.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂的教室里，教师可能需要大声说话，长期如此会损伤嗓音。

col: shout to someone｜向某人高声说话
tip: shout at常含生气意味；shout to重在让远处的人听见。

senses.en: a small money holder; in American English, a handbag
money available to a person, organisation, or government
to press your lips together into a small rounded shape

ex.en: She opened her purse and took out a coin.
ex.zh: 她打开零钱包，取出一枚硬币。

ex.en: Investment in preventive healthcare could reduce the long-term burden on the public purse.
ex.zh: 投资预防性医疗可以减轻公共财政的长期负担。

tip: 英式purse多指零钱包，美式常指女式手提包。

senses.en: Relating to the present or relatively recent times.
Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.

ex.en: Our flat has a modern kitchen with large windows.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓有一间新式厨房，窗户很大。

ex.en: Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.
ex.zh: 现代技术让偏远地区的学生能够获取过去只有城市才有的教育资源。

tip: modern强调现代或新式；不一定表示刚刚制造。

senses.en: Show or communicate a thought, feeling, or opinion.
Providing a faster service than usual.
Clearly and directly stated.

ex.en: Leah expressed her thanks with a warm smile.
ex.zh: 莉娅用一个温暖的微笑表达了谢意。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to express their opinions on decisions that affect their education.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生有机会对影响其教育的决策发表意见。

tip: express作动词直接接宾语，如express your views。

senses.en: A dark classroom board used for writing or drawing with chalk.

ex.en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个大圆圈。

ex.en: Although digital screens offer interactive features, a traditional blackboard remains an affordable teaching tool for many schools.
ex.zh: 尽管电子屏幕具有互动功能，传统黑板仍是许多学校负担得起的教学工具。

col: write on the blackboard｜在黑板上书写
tip: 在黑板上用on the blackboard；配合粉笔使用。

senses.en: Someone employed to do household work in another person's home

ex.en: The servant carried fresh towels into the guest bedroom.
ex.zh: 佣人把干净毛巾拿进了客房。

ex.en: In wealthy households of the past, servants often worked long hours with little legal protection.
ex.zh: 过去，富裕家庭的佣人往往长时间工作，却很少受到法律保护。

tip: 公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。

senses.en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time

ex.en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
ex.zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。

ex.en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
ex.zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。

col: take up a hobby｜开始培养一种爱好
a creative hobby｜创造性的业余爱好
pursue a hobby｜从事业余爱好
tip: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

senses.en: The coldest season, between autumn and spring.
To spend the winter in a particular place.

ex.en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
ex.zh: 冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。

ex.en: Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.
ex.zh: 更暖的冬季可能改变植物和迁徙动物的季节性行为，从而扰乱自然生态系统。

tip: 泛指在冬天用in winter；具体某年可用in the winter of…。

senses.en: a living thing that usually grows in soil and has leaves
to put seeds or young plants into soil to grow
a factory or facility where industrial processes take place

ex.en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
ex.zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。

ex.en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。

tip: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
ex.zh: 一只大狗正睡在那只小猫旁边。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。

tip: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。

senses.en: having greater than average height

ex.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。

ex.en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
ex.zh: 高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。

tip: 人、树、楼通常用tall；山通常用high。

senses.en: Having a lot of money or valuable possessions.
Containing a large amount or variety of something valuable.
Containing plenty of fat, cream, sugar, or strong flavour.

ex.en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
ex.zh: 他们富有的叔叔在海边拥有一栋大房子。

ex.en: Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。

col: rich in nutrients｜富含营养成分
rich cultural heritage｜丰富的文化遗产
tip: “富含……”用 rich in，不用 rich of。

senses.en: Used to make a request or offer more polite.
To make someone feel happy or satisfied.

ex.en: Could you please hold the door for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我扶一下门吗？

ex.en: Public policies designed to please every group may fail to address the most urgent social problems.
ex.zh: 旨在取悦所有群体的公共政策，可能无法解决最紧迫的社会问题。

tip: please是动词；感到满意用be pleased。

senses.en: a coloured substance spread on surfaces for protection or decoration
to cover a surface with paint
to create a picture using paint

ex.en: There is blue paint all over your hands.
ex.zh: 你的双手沾满了蓝色颜料。

ex.en: Schools should allow children to paint regularly, as creative activities can support emotional development and self-expression.
ex.zh: 学校应让孩子经常绘画，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和自我表达。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: paint多指用颜料画；draw多指用铅笔等画线条。

senses.en: The activity of buying and selling goods or services.
An organisation that sells goods or services.
Matters that someone needs to deal with or is responsible for.

ex.en: Business is usually slow at the café on Mondays.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆周一的生意通常比较清淡。

ex.en: Small businesses often create local employment, but they may struggle to compete with larger companies.
ex.zh: 小企业通常能为当地创造就业机会，但可能难以与大公司竞争。

col: none of your business｜与你无关
tip: 指商业活动时不可数；指具体企业时可数。

senses.en: before now or earlier than expected

ex.en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。

ex.en: Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 许多城市已经推出骑行计划，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。

col: already in place｜已经就位；已落实
tip: 常置于助动词后、实义动词前；表示已经或比预期早。

senses.en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.

ex.en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 你敢在大家面前发言，真勇敢。

ex.en: It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.
ex.zh: 当强势群体激烈反对时，推行必要的环境改革需要勇敢的领导力。

col: brave enough to｜有足够勇气做
tip: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

senses.en: To keep doing something or keep happening.
To start again after a pause or interruption.

ex.en: We continued walking along the beach despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是继续沿着海滩走。

ex.en: If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.
ex.zh: 如果住房成本持续上涨，更多年轻人可能难以在大城市独立生活。

tip: 可接to do或doing，通常都表示继续做某事。

senses.en: A small furry animal often kept as a pet.
An animal belonging to the same family as lions.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
ex.zh: 我们家的猫睡在窗边阳光照得到的地方。

ex.en: Keeping pet cats indoors can help protect native birds, particularly in areas with vulnerable wildlife populations.
ex.zh: 将宠物猫养在室内有助于保护本地鸟类，尤其是在野生动物种群脆弱的地区。

tip: big cats指狮、虎等大型猫科动物。

senses.en: to find something or learn something previously unknown

ex.en: We discovered a quiet beach behind the cliffs.
ex.zh: 我们在悬崖后面发现了一片安静的海滩。

ex.en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
ex.zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。

col: discover a new species｜发现新物种
tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: the drink Coca-Cola, or a bottle, can, or glass of this drink

col: ...a coke-burning stove.｜…一个烧焦炭的炉子。

senses.en: Move around a centre or change direction.
Change to a different state, colour, or condition.
An opportunity to do something in an agreed order.

ex.en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
ex.zh: 轻轻转动把手，然后朝自己这边拉门。

ex.en: As populations age, governments must turn their attention to accessible housing and community healthcare.
ex.zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府必须将注意力转向无障碍住房和社区医疗。

tip: 表示变得时，turn后接形容词；turn into后接名词。

senses.en: The gas water becomes when heated, often seen as white mist.
To cook food using steam from boiling water.

ex.en: Steam rose from the soup as I lifted the lid.
ex.zh: 我揭开盖子时，汤里升起了热气。

ex.en: Some power stations use heat to produce steam, which drives turbines and generates electricity.
ex.zh: 一些发电站利用热量产生蒸汽，推动涡轮机发电。

col: run out of steam｜耗尽精力
tip: steam作名词通常不可数；作动词可表示蒸食物。

senses.en: A recording of moving images, usually with sound.
Record moving images of someone or something.

ex.en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段企鹅在冰上滑行的视频。

ex.en: Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.
ex.zh: 教学视频可以让复杂的过程更容易理解，对背景知识有限的学生尤其如此。

tip: 一段视频用a video；泛指视频媒介时可不可数。

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought.

ex.en: It was stupid to leave my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 把伞留在家里真是太傻了。

ex.en: Calling students stupid can damage their confidence and discourage them from asking questions in class.
ex.zh: 说学生愚蠢会损害他们的信心，使他们不敢在课堂上提问。

tip: 直接说别人stupid带侮辱性，评价人时应避免。

senses.en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice
Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements

ex.en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
ex.zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。

ex.en: Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
ex.zh: 在推行新政策之前，政府应查明其他地方是否有类似的成功做法。

tip: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

senses.en: A talk in which people exchange ideas, feelings, or information.

ex.en: We had a friendly conversation while waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 等公交车时，我们友好地聊了一会儿。

ex.en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
ex.zh: 经常与语言流利的人交谈有助于语言学习者建立信心并提高听力。

tip: 与某人谈某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

senses.zh: 部分；角色；零件；一些；片段
senses.en: a piece or feature of something such as an object, area, event, or period of time
to move the two sides of something apart, or to move apart, making a space in the middle

ex.en: For part of the day, you will be outside doing practical work.
ex.zh: 你们每天将有一部分时间在户外实际操作。

senses.en: A movable barrier used to open or close an entrance.

ex.en: Please close the door before the cat gets out.
ex.zh: 请关上门，别让猫跑出去。

ex.en: Installing wider doors in public buildings can make everyday journeys easier for people who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑中安装更宽的门，可以让轮椅使用者的日常出行更方便。

tip: at the door指在门口；answer the door指应声开门。

senses.en: Sleeping rather than awake.

ex.en: The baby was asleep before we reached home.
ex.zh: 我们还没到家，宝宝就睡着了。

ex.en: People who use electronic devices late at night may find it harder to fall asleep.
ex.zh: 深夜使用电子设备的人可能更难入睡。

tip: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。

senses.en: a situation without war, fighting, or serious disagreement
a state of quietness or freedom from worry

ex.en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我喜欢早餐前这座花园里的宁静。

ex.en: Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.
ex.zh: 持久和平有赖于各群体之间的合作以及公平获取基本资源的机会。

tip: 通常不可数；peace of mind表示安心、心安。

senses.en: Only one, rather than several or many.
Not married or not in a romantic relationship.
For travel to a destination without a return journey.

ex.en: A single candle lit the room during the power cut.
ex.zh: 停电时，房间里只有一支蜡烛照明。

ex.en: No single policy can solve urban congestion without improvements to public transport and local planning.
ex.zh: 如果不改善公共交通和地方规划，任何单一政策都无法解决城市拥堵。

col: a single person｜一个人；单身人士
tip: 单程票英式常说single ticket，美式用one-way ticket。

senses.en: Show that something is true using evidence
Turn out to be a particular thing or quality

ex.en: These photos prove that our dog opened the cupboard.
ex.zh: 这些照片证明是我们的狗打开了橱柜。

ex.en: Long-term studies may prove that regular exercise improves concentration as well as physical health.
ex.zh: 长期研究可能证实，经常锻炼既能改善注意力，也能增强身体健康。

col: prove a point｜证明一个观点
prove someone wrong｜证明某人错了
tip: prove可接that从句，也可直接接形容词。

senses.en: To move on foot at a pace slower than running
A journey made on foot, often for pleasure

ex.en: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每个星期天早上都步行去面包店。

ex.en: Safe pavements and attractive public spaces encourage residents to walk rather than drive for short journeys.
ex.zh: 安全的人行道和宜人的公共空间能鼓励居民短途出行时步行而不开车。

tip: 字母l不发音；walk the dog意为遛狗。

senses.en: to try to find someone or something by looking very carefully
an attempt to find someone or something

ex.en: It was too dark to search further.
ex.zh: 天太暗，无法继续寻找。

ex.en: The area was thoroughly searched.
ex.zh: 这一地区已被彻底搜查过。

senses.en: Soft white plant fibres used to make thread and fabric.
Fabric or thread made from cotton fibres.

ex.en: This cotton shirt feels soft even after many washes.
ex.zh: 这件棉衬衫洗了很多次后摸起来仍然很柔软。

ex.en: Cotton production can place considerable pressure on water supplies, particularly in regions with limited rainfall.
ex.zh: 棉花生产会给供水带来相当大的压力，尤其是在降雨量有限的地区。

tip: 通常不可数；cotton shirt中cotton作名词定语。

senses.en: The organ that digests food, or the surrounding body area
To accept something unpleasant without feeling upset or disgusted

ex.en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时，肚子开始咕咕叫。

ex.en: Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.
ex.zh: 规律进餐可能有助于预防胃部不适，并帮助学生养成健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。
